Discover how vented dryers work their magic to produce fantastic clothing drying results while being budget-friendly appliances, requiring a low amount of maintenance in comparison to condenser models. How does a Vented Dryer work?
A vented dryer operates on a straightforward principle that's easy to understand. When you pop your wet clothes inside, the machine heats up air and blows it through your damp laundry.
